description: Local guards G1-G12 (spec 7.8). 'base' is a context that passes every guard. Each case applies 'changes' to a copy of 'base' in order ('set' the value at 'path', or 'delete' it; a path of one key replaces that key) and runs the guards in order G1..G12. 'expect' is {ok: true}, or the first refusal: {ok: false, guard, code} and, where given, the exact 'reason'. Amounts are atomic units (6 decimals); limits are dollars; times are Unix seconds. Addresses are the public anvil/hardhat default accounts, TEST ONLY.
